t: Manufactured with nylon and elastane giving a full, 4-way stretch to the garment. Features tapered leg, bottom-loading Cordura knee pad pockets and elasticated hem. Webbing tape belt loops and hammer loop. Back pockets, with re-enforced floating base, and concealed snap popper fastening.
b: 2 x Front Side, 2 x Holster, 2 x Knee Pad, 2 x Rear & 1 x Inside Tool Pocket(s)
